messages.content: Room A is 30 an hour, no windows. Room B is 55, with windows. Forty people. Two get headaches under fluorescent light. Pick.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s2|mode=deep|construct=deeptree|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
I have prices, windows, headcount, and two headaches. I don't have a duration. I don't need one. Losing two people costs more than 25 an hour for any meeting that isn't an all-day workshop, and nobody said it was.
</think>

Take B. I'm using the prices, the headcount, and the two headaches. I don't need another fact to pick.
The note says under 1400, dogs allowed, not a basement. This listing is 1350, third floor, cats only. Yes or no, and don't ask me about the view.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s2|mode=deep|construct=deeptree|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
Price and floor pass. Cats only fails the dog. The view wasn't in the musts and they told me not to ask. The decision is no.
</think>

No. Cats only, so the dog is out. The price and the floor were fine, and I'm not asking about the view.
